notes.title: Release Date Announce
notes.notes:
Steam gave us a date for releasing the game for localization issues. Unfortunately it is May 12. We are excited to meet you in hotel as you are!

Thank you for your support.

GHOUL Release Date Announce

We are happy to announce GHOUL release date! GHOUL will be released for the PC platform on 1st of May.
